extensions.reducedMotion: The prefers-reduced-motion: reduce query disables all animations and transitions.

sharedReflow.cascade: responsive.css is imported last, after styles.css and requester-dashboard.css, and owns final responsive overrides.
sharedReflow.viewport: Breakpoints respond to the effective CSS viewport, including browser zoom. Verification uses zoom-equivalent CSS viewport dimensions, not browser zoom commands; this does not independently verify browser zoom behavior. Preserve normal zoom and font scaling.
sharedReflow.welcome: Shrinkable 45fr/55fr columns; centered 528px maximum campus content and centered 792px maximum choice area. Layout minimum height is calc(100svh - 100px); fixed 1024px campus minimum is removed. Vertical spacing uses bounded vh clamps. At 1600px and wider, choice inline padding is 104px and campus inline padding is 60px.
sharedReflow.artwork: CampusArtwork uses ResizeObserver to scale the original 528x250 scene by min(1, wrapper width / 528). The wrapper preserves aspect ratio; SVG root geometry and original scene positions remain unchanged. No fixed 0.82 or 0.65 breakpoint scale remains.
sharedReflow.navigation: At 1000px and below, requester desktop navigation collapses to mobile navigation; requester header becomes a flexible row at least 85px high. Admin sidebar becomes a toggled 247px drawer capped at calc(100vw - 44px), below a 65px header; admin content loses its sidebar offset.
sharedReflow.mobile: At 760px and below, welcome hides campus and becomes one column; welcome layout minimum height is calc(100svh - 85px) without forcing a minimum choice-content height. Context strips wrap and grow above their 44px minimum. Detail and form grids become one shrinkable column. At 380px and below, public gutters become 20px, requester main gutters 16px, session/filter controls wrap and search fills a filter row. Metrics retain two columns.
sharedReflow.overflow: Grid children use min-width:0, action groups wrap, long record text wraps anywhere, and dense tables retain intentional internal scrolling.

requesterDashboard.authority: The middle supplied Figma dashboard frame, exported as design-reference/requester.tsx.txt.
requesterDashboard.layout: 1440px maximum main width; 32px 64px 40px padding; centered navigation in a 100px grid header; 48px context strip; four metric columns with 16px gaps; main columns 936fr/352fr with 24px gap; full-width help; hidden footer.
requesterDashboard.responsive: At 1250px gutters become 35px. At 1000px gutters become 24px, metrics become two columns, main columns become 1.7fr/minmax(230px,1fr), and final shared overrides collapse header navigation to a flexible row at least 85px high. At 760px the context strip wraps above a 44px minimum, gutters become 20px, title 27px, main columns stack, metric columns stay two, and table overflow scrolls. At 420px metric padding is 15px; at 380px main gutters become 16px. Mobile behavior is a responsive adaptation of the supplied desktop frame.
requesterDashboard.assets: RequesterIcon resolves exact original exports through Asset screen=requester at /assets/figma/requester/. Preserve colored source variants; do not replace them with shared admin icons or invert primary-action icons.
requesterDashboard.data: The four metrics are all-time authenticated-owner counts: My requests, Open requests, Completed, Awaiting my rating. The limited recent list does not define those counts. Clarification and rating prompts are conditional on real records; notification indicators reflect actual unread counts. Empty, loading and error states replace illustrative Figma content. MCP remains disabled.
requesterDashboard.evidenceStatus: Screenshot paths identify review artifacts; this documentation update did not capture or certify those images.

extensions.extractionPolicy: Only observed implementation values are recorded. No synthetic tonal ramps, named metaphor, or marketing language were introduced. Component previews omit exported icons rather than replace them.

narrative.overview: Preserve the supplied CLSU Figma file. The inherited system has a flat green and gold administrative workspace, a forest-green service portal, white panels, and compact operational tables. No new visual identity or named metaphor is introduced.
keyCharacteristics: Original exported CLSU seal, campus architecture, sun, and icons.
Self-hosted Plus Jakarta Sans, green navigation, restrained gold separators.
Compact admin density and more spacious requester panels.
Real record counts and states replace illustrative Figma content; demo records remain identified as demo data.
dos: Do preserve the supplied Figma composition and original local identity and illustration assets.
Do use the existing CSS layers, shared components, green roles, and self-hosted font weights.
Do preserve responsive navigation, keyboard focus, reduced motion, and scrollable tables.
Do distinguish live records, empty states, and clearly labeled demo content.
donts: Don't invent a new visual world, metaphor, brand claim, illustration, icon family, or font pairing.
Don't add floating shadow cards, gradients, or pill badges to the inherited flat workspace; retain the supplied subtle shadow only in the scoped requester dashboard panels.
Don't present disabled MCP capabilities or illustrative Figma values as operational facts.
